description: Workout sessions in progress right now among the trainer's students (the app already drops sessions abandoned by a dead app), with the session fields plus student_phone (the guardian's for a dependent) and the app_url of the student profile. Use it to answer "who is training right now?" so the trainer can cheer them on or open the workout, then get_student or list_student_sessions for one of them. Read only: nothing is sent to the student.
name: list_live_sessions
title: See who is training now
